subject: Data Engineering
title: Schema Evolution
description: A quick, practical guide to Schema Evolution.

hook.text: The marketing team needs a new column in the events table. In a raw lake, that's chaos. In a lakehouse, one command.

buildup.text: Schema evolution allows adding, renaming, or dropping columns without rewriting existing data files.

discovery.text: Table formats track schema changes in metadata. Old files use the old schema; new files use the new one.

twist.text: Not all changes are safe. Changing a column's type from string to integer can break existing queries.

climax.text: Schema evolution balances flexibility with safety — allowing growth while preventing breaking changes.

punchline.text: Add a column. Don't rewrite the lake.

quiz.question: How does schema evolution work in lakehouse table formats?
options: Changes are tracked in metadata without rewriting existing files
All files are rewritten with the new schema
A new table is created for every schema change
